For a classic cheesecake, the best substitute for cream cheese is mascarpone cheese. It has a similar high fat content and mild flavor, which helps maintain the rich, creamy texture. You may need to add a small amount of lemon juice or vinegar to mascarpone to mimic the slight tang of cream cheese. Another option is a blend of ricotta cheese (strained well to remove excess moisture) and a little butter, though this will result in a slightly grainier texture.
